Zulrah sits across the water — only a halberd has the reach to melee it, so a whip or scimitar cannot connect at all.
The kraken stays submerged and cannot be reached by melee at all, not even with a halberd.
Cave krakens cannot be meleed — a halberd technically reaches, but deals no damage.
Melee attacks cannot reach the Leviathan — use ranged or magic.
Tekton is immune to ranged. Magic works but takes 80% reduced damage, so melee is far better.

Corp halves all melee and ranged damage. Only a corpbane weapon deals full damage, and only on the style it is corpbane with: the melee corpbane weapons (spears, halberds, stab swords) must be on STAB — the same spear on slash is still halved — while King's barrage is a crossbow whose only style is RANGED. Both styles are listed in exemptStyles because allowedItemIds is the other half of the gate: no spear can attack on RANGED and no crossbow on STAB, so neither style leaks the exemption to the other group. Magic is never reduced, just inaccurate.

The tail's scales blunt most damage — max hit is capped at 4 regardless of gear, or 9 if your loadout's highest attack bonus is crush. Both tail records are listed because the broken-tail name nests its parentheses and so never reaches the base-name fallback.
